subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Organizar texto em unidades de sentido, dividindo-o em parágrafos ou tópicos e subtópicos, explorando as possibilidades de organização gráfica, de suporte e de formato do texto.

components.description_pt: Agrupar informações relacionadas em parágrafos ou seções em um texto informativo
components.description_en: Group related information into paragraphs or sections in an informational text
components.cc_component_description: Group related information into paragraphs or sections in an informational text

components.description_pt: Aplicar recursos de formatação como títulos para organizar escrita informativa
components.description_en: Apply formatting features such as headings to organize informational writing
components.cc_component_description: Apply formatting features such as headings to organize informational writing

components.description_pt: Selecionar organização gráfica, meio e formato apropriados ao propósito do texto
components.description_en: Select graphic organization, medium, and format appropriate to the text's purpose
components.cc_component_description: Select an organizational structure appropriate to the task, purpose, and audience

components.description_pt: Explicar como a estrutura organizacional de um parágrafo apoia o significado geral de um texto
components.description_en: Explain how a paragraph's organizational structure supports the overall meaning of a text
components.cc_component_description: Explain how a paragraph's organizational structure supports the overall meaning of a text

cc_matches.description: Describe the logical connection between particular sentences and paragraphs in a text (e.g., comparison, cause/effect, first/second/third in a sequence).
Introduce a topic clearly and group related information in paragraphs and sections; include formatting (e.g., headings), illustrations, and multimedia when useful to aiding comprehension.

Introduce a topic clearly, provide a general observation and focus, and group related information logically; include formatting (e.g., headings), illustrations, and multimedia when useful to aiding comprehension.
Produce clear and coherent writing in which the development, organization, and style are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience.
